categories.main_business_segments: SOHGO SECURITY SERVICES (ALSOK) operates four main business segments: Security Services (including machine security, home security, on-site security, and cash-in-transit), Facility Management (FM) services, Nursing Care services, and Overseas operations. Security Services is the core segment, providing comprehensive security solutions for corporations and individuals. FM services cover building maintenance, equipment management, and disaster prevention. Nursing Care offers a range of in-home and facility-based care, while Overseas operations focus on security and FM in Southeast Asia and other regions.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: ALSOK leverages advanced technologies such as AI-powered surveillance cameras, remote monitoring systems, and integrated security platforms (e.g., ALSOK-G7). The company develops proprietary security devices, cloud-based video storage, and employs digital transformation (DX) tools for both physical and cyber security. Robotics (patrol robots, drones), IoT sensors, and remote response systems are increasingly integrated into their service delivery, alongside traditional human guard services.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include corporations (offices, factories, financial institutions, retail chains), public sector entities (government, infrastructure, events), and individual households. ALSOK also serves the elderly population through monitoring and care services, and supports municipalities with community safety and welfare programs. Overseas, the company targets Japanese-affiliated businesses and local enterprises in Southeast Asia.
categories.geographic_coverage: ALSOK's primary market is Japan, with a nationwide network of subsidiaries and affiliates. Internationally, the company operates in six Southeast Asian countries (Thailand, Vietnam, Indonesia, India, Myanmar, Bangladesh), and has expanded its business scope in these regions to include security, FM, and related services.
categories.supply_chain_position: ALSOK operates downstream in the supply chain, directly providing end-to-end security, facility management, and care services to end-users. The company also acts as a systems integrator, combining in-house and third-party technologies to deliver comprehensive solutions.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding integrated safety and security services, digital transformation (DX), and sustainability initiatives. R&D focuses on AI, robotics, remote monitoring, cyber security, and solutions for labor shortages (automation, efficiency). The company pursues open innovation, industry-academia-government collaboration, and is committed to ESG and SDGs, including carbon neutrality and diversity.
categories.revenue_model: ALSOK primarily generates revenue through recurring service contracts (monthly fees for security, FM, and care services), equipment sales and installation, and project-based fees for facility management and construction. Additional revenue streams include consulting, system integration, and overseas operations.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: ALSOK is one of Japan's two leading security service providers, alongside SECOM. It holds a strong market position as a comprehensive safety and security solutions provider, with a broad service portfolio and nationwide reach. The company differentiates itself through integrated offerings and a strong brand (ALSOK).
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ending March 2025, ALSOK reported consolidated sales of ¥551.9 billion, with operating profit of ¥40.2 billion and net profit attributable to parent of ¥27.1 billion. The company has achieved 15 consecutive years of revenue growth and 14 years of record sales, with a stable financial base (equity ratio ~59%) and a workforce of over 64,000 employees.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: ALSOK emphasizes comprehensive, high-quality security and safety solutions that combine advanced technology with human expertise. Its value proposition centers on reliability, rapid response, and the ability to address diverse and evolving risks (physical, cyber, social). The company differentiates through integrated service offerings, nationwide coverage, and continuous innovation in both technology and service delivery.
